snippet.title: Vena (Indie Game) - Official Release Window Announcement
snippet.description:
This trailer was released as part of the German Indie Showcase, which is a subevent of the Summer Game Fest 2026.
Wishlist Vena now, or try the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4165740/Vena/
Join the communities: https://loerting.github.io/vena/
